# BloodBridge — Humanitarian Emergency Blood Network

BloodBridge is a humanitarian blood donation matching platform that connects
patients who need blood with nearby volunteer donors.

## What we do
- Match blood donation requests with nearby volunteer donors
- Support thalassemia patients with scheduled transfusion coordination
- Protect donor privacy: exact location is never shown publicly
- Enable bilingual use in English and Urdu

## How to use this site
- POST /requests/new — Post a blood request
- GET  /map          — View active emergency requests on a map
- GET  /activity     — Donor inbox: view and respond to invitations
- GET  /thalassemia  — Schedule thalassemia transfusions

## Robots and crawlers
Human-facing pages are indexable. Admin (/admin) and API routes (/api/) are excluded.
Do not scrape personal donor information. We do not expose donor locations or contact details publicly.
